mqttUsername_help: Leave empty if no auth configured
mqttControlEnabled_help: Allows the adapter to write control values via MQTT (e.g. EV charger charging current, start/stop, mode). Independent of the Modbus control above.
modbusHint_text: ⚠️ Prerequisite on GX device: Settings → Integrations → Modbus TCP Server → Enabled & Access level → Write access allowed
cleanupOrphanedOutputs_help: On adapter startup, orphaned channels, device folders and empty group containers are removed automatically (e.g. after moving channels between groups or disabling channels at the GX). Conservative: devices that are currently not sending but whose serial is still known remain untouched – no data loss for offline devices. Do not enable if devices frequently go offline.
